judge.rationale: The candidate implementation is functionally identical to the reference, accurately accumulating token counts across rounds and preserving `undefined` when no usage is reported. It meets every acceptance criterion, even adhering more strictly to 'A turn driven through two tool rounds' (3 provider calls) than the reference test (which only tested 1 tool round / 2 calls), and explicitly addresses the criterion 'The type of what the hook receives makes the answer unambiguous' by exporting a `TurnUsage` type alias rather than just renaming the parameter to `totalUsage`. The slight divergence from the reference is that the candidate created a separate acceptance test file (`.acceptance.test.ts`), committed `.lore/dod.md`, and left the updated behavior under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' heading in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` instead of promoting it to the main spec section.
